description: A concurrent client-server build tool for Scala and Java projects with Pkl configuration and BSP support.
rules: Define the build in deder.pkl and use the DederProject.pkl schema selected by its amends URL. The client selects the matching server version from that URL.
Use CreateScalaModules, CreateJavaModules, or CreateCrossModules to define modules. Match the project's source layout with the layout setting.
Inspect the build with deder modules, deder tasks, and deder plan. Use --format densejson when automation needs structured output.
Scope deder exec to the affected module and task with -m and -t. Pass an optional suite or suite#test selector to narrow test runs.
Use --log-level warning --no-color with deder exec for routine automation. Increase verbosity to diagnose failures.
Run deder shutdown after editing .deder/server.properties so the next command starts a server with the updated settings.
